abilities.desc_en: Unstoppable

abilities.desc_zh: 提升远程攻击造成的伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Increases the damage of Ranged Attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 被动：
abilities.desc_en: Passive:

abilities.title_en: This bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior provides a permanent {{var_1}} passive Armor Buff.
abilities.desc_zh: 该机器人天生坚韧的塞伯坦外观提供了永久的 {{var_1}} 被动装甲增益。
abilities.desc_en: This bot’s naturally tough Cybertronian exterior provides a permanent {{var_1}} passive Armor Buff.

abilities.desc_zh: 当生命值低于 80/60/{{var_2}} 时：
abilities.desc_en: When Health drops below 80/60/{{var_2}}:

abilities.title_zh: 威震天变得势不可挡，持续 {{var_3}} 秒。
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天变得势不可挡，持续 {{var_3}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron becomes Unstoppable for {{var_3}}seconds.

abilities.title_en: If Megatron misses a Heavy Attack while Unstoppable he has a {{var_4}} chance to increase Attack by {{var_5}} for {{var_6}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果威震天在势不可挡时错过了重击，他有 {{var_4}} 机会通过 {{var_5}} 增加 {{var_6}} 的攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: If Megatron misses a Heavy Attack while Unstoppable he has a {{var_4}} chance to increase Attack by {{var_5}} for {{var_6}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 所有攻击
abilities.desc_en: All Attacks

abilities.title_en: Megatron inflicts an Impair Charge. Impair Charges power-up Megatron’s Tank Cannon, used during Heavy Attacks and Special Attack 3.
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天造成损害指控。削弱冲锋可以增强威震天的坦克炮，在重击和特殊技 3 期间使用。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron inflicts an Impair Charge. Impair Charges power-up Megatron’s Tank Cannon, used during Heavy Attacks and Special Attack 3.

abilities.desc_zh: 关于重击
abilities.desc_en: On Heavy Attacks

abilities.title_en: Megatron gains +{{var_7}} Critical Chance for each Impair Charge on the opponent. If Megatron scores a Critical Hit, he consumes those charges and inflicts {{var_8}} Critical Damage per stack consumed.
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天对对手的每一个损伤球都会获得 +{{var_7}} 暴击率。如果威震天获得暴击，他会消耗这些能量并每消耗一层造成 {{var_8}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron gains +{{var_7}} Critical Chance for each Impair Charge on the opponent. If Megatron scores a Critical Hit, he consumes those charges and inflicts {{var_8}} Critical Damage per stack consumed.

abilities.desc_zh:
威震天总会回来的。几乎死亡时恢复生命值。

被动：威震天总会回来。当生命值低于 {{var_9}} 时，威震天会将其基础生命值的 {{var_10}} 修复到 {{var_11}} 以上。

+每级大约 {{var_12}}。
abilities.desc_en:
All Hail Megaton!
Megatron always comes back. Regenerates Health when almost dead.
Passive: Megatron always comes back. When Health drops below {{var_9}}, Megatron Repairs {{var_10}} of his base Health over {{var_11}}.
+about {{var_12}} per level.

abilities.desc_zh: 对手被降级为无足轻重的下属。
abilities.desc_en: Overpower - Opponents are relegated to insignificant underlings.

abilities.desc_zh: 造成 10 点损害费用。
abilities.desc_en: Inflicts 10 Impair Charges.

abilities.desc_zh: 通过征服实现统一。
abilities.desc_en: Peace and Tyranny - Unification through subjugation.

abilities.title_zh: 敌人 – 擎天柱 (MV1)、大黄蜂 (DOTM)
abilities.desc_en: Enemies – Optimus Prime (MV1), Bumblebee (DOTM) - {{var_17}}~{{var_18}} Attack Rating.

abilities.title_zh: 锻造领先——研磨机、碎骨机、路障
abilities.title_en: Forged to Lead – Grindor, Bonecrusher, Barricade
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天的每个爪牙都为他提供了独特的能力。作为回报，威震天为每个机器人提供 {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} 装甲。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Lead – Grindor, Bonecrusher, Barricade - Megatron’s minions each provide him with a unique ability. In return Megatron provides {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} Armor to each bot.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天有 {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 机会开始战斗不可阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Grindor - Megatron has a {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} chance to begin the fight Unstoppable.

abilities.desc_zh: 当敌人达到 20 个削弱球时，威震天将获得 {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} 几率击晕敌人。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Bonecrusher - Megatron gains a {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} chance to Stun an enemy when they reach 20 Impair Charges.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天有 {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} 几率每次击中造成 2 个损伤球。
abilities.desc_en: Forged to Serve – Barricade - Megatron has a {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} chance to inflict 2 Impair Charges per hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为领导力的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都会获得 +{{var_27}} 特殊伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of Leadership, all lower tiers teammate gain +{{var_27}} Special Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 您团队中的所有霸天虎在与霸天虎战斗时获得 +{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} 装甲值，在与汽车人战斗时获得 +{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} 功率率。
abilities.desc_en: All Decepticons on your team gain +{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} Armor while fighting Decepticons and +{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} Power Rate while fighting Autobots.
